VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque` falls back in C to XOR with the volatile zero global `mbedtls_ct_zero`, so both the mechanism and the global are named. It never says `extern`, but the item doesn't hinge on that word.
